createDescription: Add a new user group. Module grants give every member access to those modules.
editDescription: Update group name, description and module grants.
deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete the group "{{name}}"? Members lose any module access this group granted. This action cannot be undone.
listDescription: One grouping concept: groups carry members, optional module grants, and act as sharing targets.

admins.name: Administrators
admins.description: Built-in: administrators bypass module permissions and can access everything.
admins.membersDescription: Adding a member promotes them to administrator; removing demotes them.
admins.addDescription: Search a user to promote to administrator.

default.name: Default
default.description: Built-in: users in no group fall back to these modules.
default.editDescription: Set the modules visible to users who belong to no group. A user placed in any group uses that group's modules instead.
default.membersDescription: Applies to every user not in any group; membership is implicit, so there is nothing to add here.

membersDescription: View and manage members of the selected group.
selectGroup: Select a group to view its members.
createMemberDescription: Search for a user to add to this group.
